purpose: Previously unseen source-family test catalog for the baseline-anchored physical decoder study.
claim_boundary: Sources select defensive simulator priors only; they do not provide transition targets or labels.
No exploit instructions, credentials, payloads, network addresses or operational intrusion steps are retained.
The generated test remains Ferrum simulator evidence informed by real incidents, not replay of the reported systems.
Every family in this catalog was absent from the v1 and v2 incident catalogs when v5 was registered.

sources.title: Bexar County Man Indicted for Tampering with Public Water Systems
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model unauthorized well and pump control as an unapproved actuator request against degraded process state.
sources.limitations: The cited indictment contains allegations, not an adjudicated technical reconstruction.

sources.title: Brunswick Corporation Current Report on Form 8-K, June 2023
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model paused operations across affected facilities as controller unavailability with bounded fallback.
sources.limitations: The filing reports facility disruption but does not expose physical-control telemetry.

sources.title: Sensata Technologies Current Report on Form 8-K, April 2025
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model temporary shipping, receiving and manufacturing loss as offline control with bounded manual fallback.
sources.limitations: The filing reports business impact, not control-loop measurements.

sources.title: Artivion Current Report on Form 8-K, December 2024
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model order and shipping disruption as partial service loss with constrained recovery actions.
sources.limitations: The filing does not establish compromise of physical controllers.

sources.title: Americold Realty Trust Current Report on Form 8-K, April 2023
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model intentionally offlined facility systems as stale visibility with manual continuity constraints.
sources.limitations: The filing gives facility-level impact but no sensor-level trace.

sources.title: Johnson Controls Current Report on Form 8-K, November 2023
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model application outages as reduced link quality and incomplete supervisory visibility.
sources.limitations: The filing describes enterprise disruption and does not attribute physical actuator movement.

sources.title: MKS Instruments Current Report on Form 8-K, February 2023
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model affected facilities as offline assets whose recovery commands require verified state and approval.
